risk_if_not_implemented: Without Compliance As Code (CAC) Credential Lifecycle Management, automated control assurance results may be manipulated, misattributed or lose integrity, causing misplaced confidence in control effectiveness. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Excessive or Unauthorized Privilege (R-AC-2), Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Identity Compromise / Impersonation (R-AC-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Authenticator Management
compensating_control_1.description:
Mechanisms exist to:
(1) Securely manage authenticators for users and devices; and
(2) Ensure the strength of authentication is appropriate to the classification of the data being accessed.
compensating_control_1.justification: Authenticator Management (IAC-14) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Compliance As Code (CAC) Credential Lifecycle Management (IAC-52) by restricting system and data access through alternative identity and access management mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: User Provisioning & De-Provisioning
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize a formal user registration and de-registration process that governs the assignment of access rights.
compensating_control_2.justification: User Provisioning & De-Provisioning (IAC-04) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Compliance As Code (CAC) Credential Lifecycle Management (IAC-52) by restricting system and data access through alternative identity and access management mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
